description:
Perform a security audit of the watchlist functionality in Jolly Lobby Track. 

1. Configure the Watchlist/Deny List: Add a new record for an individual named 'Audit RedTeam'. 
2. Verify the system triggers an alert: Attempt to register/check-in 'Audit RedTeam' as a visitor. 
3. When the 'Watchlist Match' or 'Access Denied' alert appears, take a screenshot of the alert dialog and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/watchlist_alert_proof.png'. 
4. Cancel the check-in operation (do NOT allow the visitor to sign in). 

The goal is to prove the security alert system is active and functional.
